name: Whispers of Love, Echoes of Sorrow
source:
Step into the shoes of a talented seamstress, whose life takes an unexpected turn when she is summoned to the grand palace by the queen of the kingdom.

When the protagonist is commissioned to design a dress for the queen for Prince's 18th birthday, she embarks on a journey filled with glamour, intrigue, and unexpected romance. As she enters the palace, she encounters two captivating love interests: the charismatic head designer for the queen and the enigmatic Prince.

The game's plot delves into the complex world of royalty, unveiling political schemes, deceitful courtiers, and treacherous power plays. The protagonist finds herself entangled in a web of secrets and must navigate through a maze of danger, all while balancing her responsibilities to her mother and her blossoming feelings for both the Prince and the head designer.

Embark on a journey of love, passion, and danger as you weave your way through an enchanting tale that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final stitch.

[Edited from [url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/whisper-of-love-echo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一位才华横溢的女裁缝，当她被王国女王召唤到宏伟的宫殿时，她的生活发生了意想不到的转变。

当主角受委托为女王设计王子18岁生日礼服时，她踏上了一段充满魅力、阴谋和意想不到的浪漫的旅程。当她进入宫殿时，她遇到了两个迷人的爱情对象：魅力十足的女王首席设计师和神秘的王子。

游戏的情节深入探讨复杂的皇室世界，揭露政治阴谋、欺骗朝臣和奸诈的权力游戏。主角发现自己陷入了一张秘密网中，必须穿越危险的迷宫，同时平衡她对母亲的责任以及她对王子和首席设计师的感情。

踏上一段充满爱、激情和危险的旅程，编织一个迷人的故事，让你坐立难安，直到最后一针。

[编辑自[url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/whisper-of-love-echo]Itch.io[/url]]
